notes.title: Update notes for June 30th
notes.content:
Big end of the monTh paTch!

[*] Various optimizations.
[*] Many fixes for audio voices not playing correctly.
[*] Fix for tornado jump issue.
[*] Fixed ballet lesson tornado jump issue.
[*] Fixed main menu door not opening/closing blocking the menu.
[*] Fix for Dog falling off of Station B.
[*] Simplified shop visited logic.
[*] Ensure that we always use latest hair and hair color.
[*] Added decals to T house.
[*] Fix for Teen being able to pickup invisible coins.
[*] Fixed players being able to walk through NPC doors.
[*] Reduce scare birds achievement cooldown from 3 minutes to 3 seconds.
[*] Fixing up eye animation curve tracks to ensure they are all stepped.
[*] Adjusting Teen's tornado start animation and state blending logic for entering and exiting tornado.
[*] Fixed a soft-lock issue with unicycles and tornado transitions.
[*] Tweaked the Remote minigame in Episode 3 to make it clearer how to progress.
[*] Added Wardrobe/Shoe Cubby confirmation popup in Episode 4, to prevent accidentally exiting with unintended clothes.
[*] Removed Dog "No Hat" rule form EP01 stages after wardrobe is available.
[*] Fixed many places where a train carriage would disappear if you paused.
[*] Fixed an issue that was blocking the Tornado ability after Episode 4.
[*] In Episode 4 altered skin color now stays until the end of the Episode.
[*] Fixed math teacher falling down after dialogue when doing yoga in Final Episode.
[*] Fix for t-Shirt building fade during Episode 5.
[*] Fixed player collision for train race and dog races.
[*] Fix for the Episode 5 Balloon cutscene not playing.
[*] Fixed feet shuffling and bad nose during dialogues.
[*] Cereal color variations per episode.
[*] Relaxed the input criteria for Pet Dog.
[*] Added Photosensitive warning message.
[*] Fixed Mother Flashlight state getting out of sync.
[*] Add door open/close audio to main menu door.
[*] Fixed issues with skip button not showing up.
[*] Fixing some floating trees and foliage around town.
[*] Fixed end credit double trains issue.
[*] Various customization fixes.
[*] Various DOF fixes.
[*] Various Lod fixes.

Thank you for your supporT!
